FIELDS.NAME: Savory Bites Café
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Savory Bites Café specializes in a full-service dining experience that offers a diverse menu focusing on fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Our establishment features a seating capacity of up to 150 customers within a cozy and inviting atmosphere, conveniently located in a 7,500 square foot space. We pride ourselves on our attentive service, with a staff trained to provide excellent customer care while ensuring compliance with safety standards. Our operational hours are designed to accommodate lunch and dinner diners, creating a family-friendly environment. We maintain a robust risk management protocol, having implemented all necessary fire safety measures and ensuring all cooking appliances are equipped with appropriate fire suppression systems. The location operates year-round, with a focus on continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 12, 2023, a small kitchen fire caused by cooking grease igniting damaged equipment and a section of the wall, resulting in a total loss of $1,500. The incident was promptly extinguished with no injuries reported and all necessary fire safety protocols were followed. Status: Resolved. Additionally, on July 8, 2023, a customer slipped on a wet floor while entering the dining area, leading to a liability claim for medical expenses amounting to $1,000. Status: Currently under review by insurance.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel safe, Class B, UL listed, 4-hour fire rating.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitoring services with secured access control and perimeter fencing.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Savory Bites Café does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The focus is solely on food service within a compliant safety framework.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Savory Bites Café does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its operational activities or community involvement. The focus remains on providing a quality dining experience rather than engaging in sponsorships.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are typically checked by the management or designated personnel responsible for compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There has been no indictment or conviction for any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with Savory Bites Café or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Savory Bites Café has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We have maintained a consistent insurance history with our current and previous carriers.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Savory Bites Café does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff members are directly employed by the café. This allows for consistent training and management of our service standards.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Savory Bites Café carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and provides coverage for its employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Savory Bites Café also owns and operates Savory Bites Catering Services, LLC, which complements its restaurant operations by providing catering services for various events.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Savory Bites Café does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We only maintain the current policy listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Savory Bites Café is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations strictly focus on providing a dining experience with food service.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Savory Bites Café does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its operations. The focus is solely on providing a full-service dining experience without engaging in equipment rentals.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – There have been no foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens associated with Savory Bites Café during the past five years. The financial standing remains stable and compliant with all regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Savory Bites Café does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond standard kitchen operations, as all necessary fire safety measures and protocols are in place.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Savory Bites Café does not have any known catastrophe exposure, as the operations are designed with robust safety protocols and risk management measures in place.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Savory Bites Café has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The establishment maintains a strong commitment to safety and compliance in all operational aspects.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Savory Bites Café has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains all necessary fire safety measures in compliance with regulations.
